Independent algebraic check of generator identities, concavity endpoints, and exact rational witness
correctness.rationale: On a compact interior support, extend any continuous risk test h to a neighborhood and differentiate a primitive of h(r)/[r(1−r)] along the flow. Its invariant integral is zero, so continuous tests annihilate the signed risk marginal of x−χ, proving E[x|r]=χ and the covariance statement for bounded measurable tests. The cost and cooperation log odds have generator derivatives (α−β)[θ₁−θ₄−(θ₁+θ₂)x+(θ₃+θ₄)r] and BrF(x)−c, yielding E[r]=η and the cost identity. For p=M−1, q=N−M, d=p+q−1, the quadratic bracket in F″ at the two joins is −(p−1)q/d and −p(q−1)/d. Convexity of the bracket makes it nonpositive throughout the central interval. Maximizing F(s)/s and F(s)/(1−s) gives the endpoint tangencies, including omitted chords when p or q is 1, and concavity forces any majorant above those chords. Conditional Jensen and r>0 give β<E[c]≤BηH(χ). Empirical time averages of a compact forward orbit have invariant weak limits; positive eventual distance from the boundary would give precisely such an orbit closure. For sharpness of the moment relaxation use r=η and the appropriate chord-endpoint mixture for x, or x=χ on the central interval. Contracting the x-mixture toward χ gives interior approximations without changing the moments. In the rational example u₋=1/3 and F(1/3)=8/27, giving H(1/10)=4/45 and BηH(χ)=16/225<β=2/25. The mean-only coupling gives 4/45, strictly above β, and violates risk calibration.
residual_risks: No full rerun of the corroborating rational mesh checker or formal verification. The obstruction is necessary, not sufficient; the moment optimum does not construct an invariant law or select a boundary attractor.

evidence: The collapse result proves stronger trajectory behavior when its Δ>0, equivalent here to η<0. The odds clock excludes compact interior sets for η outside (0,1), and the saturation theorem treats η≥1 with explicit rates for η>1.
The Lotka–Volterra proof uses a primitive satisfying H′(x)=φ(x)/x, leading to the analogous conditional expectation in that system.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Credit the out-of-range exclusions and methodological overlap. Neither stronger boundary asymptotics in those regimes nor the earlier model-specific generator test covers the present β versus BηH(χ) case with 0<η<1.

evidence: The known envelope alone only bounds F averaged under a prescribed mean; with the two marginal means the explicit three-atom example still gives 4/45, not 16/225. The earlier conditional test is for Lotka–Volterra, not the risk fiber of this model.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The adaptation to the evolving risk coordinate followed by risk-weighted conditional Jensen is the additional deduction. Marginal or equilibrium analyses do not justify conditioning the sharp envelope at a common χ for all risk values.

evidence: Wang et al.'s interior equilibrium coordinates simplify to x*=χ, r*=η and c*=Br*F(x*). This gives the time average identities for a point mass, not E[x|r]=χ for other invariant laws.
The risk–cost odds-clock result gives marginal Cesàro means, and the Lotka–Volterra result gives actual conditional calibration for different coordinates in another flow.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The invariant form equivalent to the distinctive calibration is E[(x−χ)h(r)]=0 for every bounded measurable h. Neither fixed-point coordinates nor two marginal means are equivalent to that family of identities.

evidence: 276990ec2acf gives the identical scalar majorant under n=N−1, k=M−1, p=s. The PLOS table classifies equilibria and gives no comparable invariant-measure bound. The odds-clock indexed result matches the out-of-range exclusion and marginal means.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: There is exact coverage of components, not a table or indexed formula furnishing the stated conditional calibration and cost ceiling for interior η.

value.rationale: Equilibrium coordinates do not settle whether periodic, aperiodic, or other compact interior invariant dynamics persist. The conditional law gives a usable parameter test that forbids all such interior dynamics even where the two marginal means alone cannot certify the obstruction, as the exact witness demonstrates. The proof distinguishes a sharp probabilistic ceiling from any stronger claim of dynamical attainability or global convergence.
residual_risks: The test is specific to the Model 1 feedback structure; it does not classify attractors or imply empirical behavior.
